title: Translation materials
description: Organize context, terminology and reviewed translations for backup and sharing.

exchange.title: Backup & sharing
exchange.help: Review imported content and scope. Export files for others or an external AI agent to maintain.

editor.entry_help: Saving does not approve an entry. Check its translation, sources and scope before approval.
editor.expression_help: Explains expressions present in the source; never adds mannerisms to other lines.
editor.memory_help: Reviewed translations provide examples and never directly replace new output.
editor.scope_help: Organization is separate from scope. Select required subjects and roles below; all conditions must match.
editor.source_existing: Leave blank to keep existing sources; a note adds a source record.
editor.source_default: If blank, the entered content is recorded as a manual source.
editor.adopt: I checked the content and scope; approve this entry on save
editor.language_defaults: Language defaults apply to new entries only.
editor.style_help: A style must reference at least one rule. Create rules in Materials first.
editor.suggestion_help: Roles are suggestions; each translation still needs its own content and speaker scope confirmation.
editor.archive_help: Archiving preserves content and history. Edit again to restore it.
editor.create_collection_first: Create a collection first, then add terms or context.
editor.expression_scope: Expressions about a person require that person's speaker role. Confirm it under scope.
editor.language_change: Changing languages clears incompatible style or rule selections.
editor.dependencies: Saving includes collections required by the selected styles.

plans.notice: Approved background, terms and rules are available for checks and independent trials in Subtitle Studio. Formal translation and global preference inheritance are not enabled yet.

empty.materials: Start with a few terms and context notes
empty.materials_help: Create a collection and add entries, or import a prepared knowledge file.
empty.filtered: No materials match. Adjust filters or search terms.
empty.plans_help: Prepare translation rules, then create styles or material plans.

scope.general_help: No specific subject required within the given language pair.

detail.revision: Revision {{revision}} · Saving edits creates a new revision

success.reject: Suggestion rejected. It remains in all materials.

import.title: Review import
import.trust_help: External files cannot approve entries for you. Imports await review; conflicts keep your local version by default.
import.warning_generic: Some material needs attention. Check its content and scope before importing.
import.same_revision: Same revision, different content. Keep local or create a copy; replacement is unavailable.
import.adopt_ready: I checked the {{count}} entries marked ready. Approve selected versions on import; candidates still require review.

export.title: Export knowledge file
export.description: Save an importable knowledge file for backup, sharing or further editing.
export.share_help: Select collections or plans. Approved, ready materials are included by default; the preview lists required materials and styles.
export.backup_help: Includes all candidates, archives, reviewed translations, plans, styles and preferences. Excludes subtitle files and model keys.
export.memories: Include reviewed translations and required source excerpts
export.memories_help: Reviewed translations may contain full dialogue or personal content. Check suitability before including them.
export.backup_memories: A full backup includes all reviewed translations and required source excerpts.
export.preview_workflow: Select content, inspect included materials and excerpts, then save. Changing options requires a new preview.
export.inactive: Include rejected, archived and inactive materials
export.exclude_sources_help: Excluding a source excludes entire dependent entries without rewriting records. Resolve any missing plan dependencies before export.
export.preview_required: No current preview. Review included content before choosing a save location.
export.dependency_collection: Required by a plan or style

errors.unexpected: The operation failed. Your input is preserved; please retry.
errors.required: Fill in required fields and check selected materials and languages.
errors.invalid_input: The format or references are invalid. Check the content and retry.
errors.access_denied: Cannot access this file or material. Select it again.
errors.storage_unavailable: Materials are unavailable. Refresh and retry.
errors.revision_conflict: Materials changed. Close and reopen this item, review the latest content, then save.
errors.plan_expired: This preview expired. Generate a new preview, or close and reopen this item.
errors.import_conflict: Import choices have conflicting references. Adjust them or preview again.
errors.not_found: Material not found. Refresh and retry.
errors.write_failed: Saving failed; existing materials are preserved. Check disk space and retry.
errors.limit_exceeded: Materials exceed size or count limits. Split them and retry.
errors.file_exists: This file already exists. Choose another name.
errors.unsupported_destination: This location cannot safely create the knowledge file. Save to a writable local folder, then copy it to your backup drive.

diagnostic.CONFLICT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Conflicting identities require review after import.
diagnostic.LANGUAGE_TAG: Use explicit language tags, such as ja, en, zh-Hans or zh-Hant.
diagnostic.SPEAKER_NOT_PERSON: A speaker must be a person.
diagnostic.EXPRESSION_SPEAKER_REQUIRED: A person's expression requires their speaker scope.
diagnostic.KEEP_SOURCE_TARGET: When keeping source, target text must equal source text.
diagnostic.REQUIRED_ADVISORY: Required rules need confirmation for scenario conditions.
diagnostic.RECIPE_STYLE_COLLECTION: The plan is missing a collection required by its styles.
diagnostic.RECIPE_LEARNING_DESTINATION: Select a destination collection for reviewed translations.
diagnostic.DERIVATION_REVISION_CHANGED: Derivation uses an older revision; review its excerpt.
diagnostic.MEMORY_ALIGNMENT_REVIEW: Confirm the translation and source segment were human reviewed.
diagnostic.AI_PROPOSAL_READY: An AI proposal cannot approve itself; review the content.
diagnostic.STYLE_NOT_READY: A style's rule or related material is not ready.
diagnostic.RECIPE_STYLE_ARCHIVED: The plan contains an archived style.
diagnostic.TERM_TRANSLATION_CONFLICT: A term has competing translations; check scope and sources.
diagnostic.TRIAL_ONLY_EXECUTION: Approved background, terms and rules are available for checks and independent trials in Subtitle Studio. Formal translation and global preference inheritance are not enabled yet.
diagnostic.PURGE_TASK_REFERENCED: Execution records still retain these materials. You can archive them; permanent removal is available once related documents and history no longer retain them.
diagnostic.PURGE_TASK_SCAN_INCOMPLETE: Some document records could not be fully checked. Resolve unavailable documents or retained remnants before permanently removing materials.

languages.custom_help: Use an explicit language tag such as it, vi or zh-Hans; automatic detection is not supported.
languages.invalid: Enter a canonical language tag; Chinese requires zh-Hans or zh-Hant.

drop.hint: Drop one knowledge file to import
drop.invalid: Drop one .fktk.json file at a time. Existing materials are unchanged.

maintenance.history_help: Review imports, undo supported imports, or remove unreferenced sources.
maintenance.preview_help: Review the impact before confirming. Previewing does not change your materials.
maintenance.archive_help: Archiving preserves materials and history. Related records may need review.
maintenance.restore_help: Restoring does not reapprove old versions. Review content and scope afterward.
maintenance.undo_help: Only this import is undone. Later edits, approvals or new references block the entire undo.
maintenance.history_warning: This also removes all {{snapshots}} local history snapshots. {{count}} imports will lose undo support.
maintenance.purge_help: Removes listed current records and all local history content. Other current records and external backups remain. This cannot be undone.
maintenance.confirm_history: I understand that all local material history and related undo support will be removed, and confirm permanent removal
maintenance.tasks_not_connected: Translation task tracking is not connected yet. This preview cannot establish whether past tasks are affected.
maintenance.cleanup_pending: Removal is saved, but history cleanup is pending. You can view materials; changes, imports and exports pause until cleanup finishes.
maintenance.unused_sources_help: Current entries do not reference these sources. Permanent removal still requires impact and history review.
maintenance.saved_version: These actions use the saved version. Save edits before maintenance.
maintenance.imports_losing_undo: View imports that will lose undo support
maintenance.task_references_help: Current tasks and retained historical execution records may reference these materials and prevent permanent removal. A reference means the record retains the materials; it does not mean all content was sent to the model.
maintenance.task_references_unknown: References could not be fully checked for {{count}} documents. The materials cannot yet be confirmed as unreferenced.
maintenance.no_related_records: No related execution records were found.

trial.title: Materials check & trial translation
trial.description: Choose materials, check their scope, then try up to 20 cues. Results stay in this window.
trial.language_help: Specify the source and target languages of the subtitles. Mixed languages are not detected; simplified and traditional Chinese match separately.
trial.empty: No collections yet. You can still try translating without materials.
trial.cues_help: With no selection, use the first 20 cues in the file. Or select cues from this page. Changing the sample clears scope confirmations.
trial.scope: Confirm topics and speakers per cue
trial.scope_help: Check once to load the sample, then confirm each cue. Recipe speakers are suggestions only. Keep unknown speakers unset and check again after edits.
trial.speaker: Confirmed speaker
trial.disable: Disable entries for this trial (resolve conflicts)
trial.error: The check or trial did not finish. Verify the configuration, model and file, then check again.
trial.more_issues: Showing the first 100 of {{count}} notices. Reduce the selected materials and check again.
trial.partial_result: Trial incomplete; returned results are shown below
trial.cost_help: A trial sends the sample and applicable materials to the selected model and may incur charges. It does not save official translations, confirm content or learn from it. Knowledge enhancement for regular translation is not enabled yet.

issue.selection_invalid: Invalid selection or scope. Confirm again.
issue.resource_limit: Selected materials or term matches exceed the trial check limit. Use fewer materials or a shorter sample.
issue.resource_missing: Required material is missing or library cleanup is pending.
issue.resource_archived: Material or a required subject is archived.
issue.style_unavailable: Rules required by the recipe style are unavailable.
issue.language_mismatch: Language or translation direction does not match.
issue.untrusted: This version has not been approved locally and is excluded.
issue.unsupported_kind: Expressions and reference translations are not used in the current translation.
issue.subject_unbound: A required topic or subject role is unconfirmed; entry excluded.
issue.speaker_conflict: Multiple confirmed speakers overlap in a cue. Adjust the scope.
issue.condition_unconfirmed: Additional conditions are unconfirmed for these cues; entry excluded.
issue.no_match: This term does not occur in the source.
issue.term_conflict: Conflicting term translations in the same cue. Resolve mandatory conflicts; conflicting optional suggestions are excluded.
issue.rule_conflict: Rules in the same dimension conflict. Choose which rules to use.
issue.budget_excluded: Optional material was excluded to fit the request budget.
issue.budget_required: A single cue and required materials exceed the model budget. Shorten requirements or reduce core materials.
issue.preferences_not_applied: Global translation preferences are not inherited yet; recipe requirements remain available.
issue.required_term_suspect: The literal required term was not found. Review this translation.

trial.materials_changed: Materials changed. Earlier condition confirmations were cleared. Review the updated materials and check again.

full.title: Translate the full document with materials
full.description: Check all subtitles in this file (up to 2,000 nonempty cues) and create a task using the selected materials, recipe, and requirements.
full.topics_help: Select up to 20 subjects that the whole document is about. They apply only as topics, not as the speaker or a mentioned subject of every cue. Leave this empty to add no document topics.
full.no_topics: There are no available subjects in the library.
full.scope_help: Topics, speakers, mentioned subjects, and condition confirmations assigned in the excerpt remain limited to those cues. To change them, return to the excerpt trial to select and check cues.
full.plan_expired: The check is no longer valid. Check again before starting.
full.start_help: Starting creates a translation track and task. View progress or cancel from translation tasks. Excerpt trial translations are not copied into the official result.
full.cost_help: Checking does not request the model. Starting translation sends requests to the configured model and may incur charges. Usage estimates are approximate; actual usage comes from the provider.
